newsitem.title: FINLAND: Aros rates Nokia above Ericsson.
newsitem.headline: Aros rates Nokia above Ericsson.

text.p: Finnish telecommunications group Nokia Oy is a better investment than its Swedish rival Ericsson, Nordic securities house Aros said on Wednesday.
"Nokia is a better investment than Ericsson at current prices," an Aros telecommunications analyst said by telephone.
Aros published a research report on Nokia and Ericsson last week but the report was not available for the media, the analyst said.
At 1505/1305 GMT, Nokia traded at 306.50 markka, down 6.50 markka or little over two percent. Turnover was fair at 135 million markka.
In Stockholm, Ericsson traded seven crowns lower at 233.50.
